x: Arthur Penstone came up with a nice little run of "The Belgravian" from the early '30s and Tom Morell has passed on some copies of "Amateur Athlete", a weekly produced by Armour Milne during the War years.

Armour Milne and others had brought out modest gazettes but they were unable to survive for long. If it had not been for his posting to Germany Charlie might well have joined his friend in this ambitious enterprise.
Battersea Park was closed and we moved to Tooting Bec and members were advised to read "The Amateur Athlete", an Armour Milne weekly publication, to keep abreast of matters.
